text:
Copper(II) sulfate is prepared by adding excess copper(II) carbonate to sulfuric acid.
Why is an excess of copper(II) carbonate added?
A
to ensure all the copper(II) carbonate has reacted
B
to ensure all the sulfuric acid has reacted
C
to increase the rate of reaction
D
to increase the amount of copper(II) sulfate produced

options.label: A
options.text: to ensure all the copper(II) carbonate has reacted

options.label: B
options.text: to ensure all the sulfuric acid has reacted

options.label: C
options.text: to increase the rate of reaction

options.label: D
options.text: to increase the amount of copper(II) sulfate produced
